title: Who Struck Lakshmana? The Second Mountain
source: Valmiki Ramayana, Yuddha Kanda 6.88-89 (Critical Edition; vulgate 6.101-102)

captions.instagram:
Who really struck Lakshmana with that spear?

We all sing it in the Hanuman Chalisa: "Laaye Sajeevan Lakhan jiyaaye." In Valmiki's Ramayana this is Hanuman's SECOND trip to the herb mountain (the first is in Part 1). Here the spear that strikes Lakshmana is thrown not by Meghnad but by Ravana himself, a spear made by Maya. The vanara chief Sushena sees Lakshmana is alive and sends Hanuman to the mountain Jambavan had described. Hanuman says: "I don't know those herbs, so I brought the whole peak." Goswami Tulsidas's Ramcharitmanas says the same. Both are told with devotion.

Did you grow up hearing Meghnad threw the spear? 👇 Jai Bajrang Bali!

📜 Source: Valmiki Ramayana, Yuddha Kanda 6.88-89 (Critical Edition; vulgate 6.101-102)

captions.youtube_description:
Who really struck Lakshmana with that spear?

We all sing it in the Hanuman Chalisa: "Laaye Sajeevan Lakhan jiyaaye." In Valmiki's Ramayana this is Hanuman's SECOND trip to the herb mountain (the first is in Part 1). Here the spear that strikes Lakshmana is thrown not by Meghnad but by Ravana himself, a spear made by Maya. The vanara chief Sushena sees Lakshmana is alive and sends Hanuman to the mountain Jambavan had described. Hanuman says: "I don't know those herbs, so I brought the whole peak." Goswami Tulsidas's Ramcharitmanas says the same. Both are told with devotion.

Did you grow up hearing Meghnad threw the spear? 👇 Jai Bajrang Bali!

Source: Valmiki Ramayana, Yuddha Kanda 6.88-89 (Critical Edition; vulgate 6.101-102)
Verses:
• Ravana (not Indrajit) hurled the Maya-made shakti, which struck Lakshmana's chest — 6.88.30-35
• Sushena saw Lakshmana was alive — 6.89.9-11
• Sushena sent Hanuman to the herb mountain described before by Jambavan — 6.89.13-16
• Hanuman did not know the herbs and brought the whole peak — 6.89.17-21
• Sushena crushed the herb and gave it through the nose; Lakshmana rose free of pain — 6.89.22-24
• Hanuman Chalisa chaupai 11: 'लाय सजीवन लखन जियाये। श्री रघुवीर हरषि उर लाये॥' — Hanuman Chalisa 11
• Ramcharitmanas: Meghnad hurls the shakti at Lakshmana; Hanuman cannot tell the herb and uproots the mountain — Ramcharitmanas, Lanka Kand (doha 54-57)
• This was the second herb-mountain trip; the first is in 6.61 — 6.61.55-68

verify_note: CE 6.61.1-4,12: Indrajit's Brahmastra fells Rama, Lakshmana and 67 crore monkeys. 6.61.7,13-17: Hanuman and Vibhishana search with torches at night; old Jambavan, covered in arrows, can't see, knows Vibhishana by voice. 6.61.18: asks if Hanuman lives. 6.61.19-20: Vibhishana asks why Hanuman before the princes. 6.61.21-22: 'while he lives the beaten army is unbeaten; if he dies we are dead though alive'. 6.61.24: Hanuman clasps his feet. 6.61.29-34: Himalaya, between Rishabha and Kailasa, four herbs. 6.61.58: the herbs hide. 6.61.59-61: angry speech to the mountain, uproots the peak. 6.61.63: like a rival sun on the sun's path. 6.61.67: the fragrance frees both princes of arrows; monkey heroes rise. 6.61.68: he carries the mountain back to the Himalaya and rejoins Rama. 6.88.30-35: Ravana hurls the Maya-made shakti; it strikes Lakshmana's chest. 6.89.9-16: Sushena: not dead; sends Hanuman to the mountain 'described before by Jambavan'. 6.89.17-21: he doesn't know the herbs, brings the peak. 6.89.22-24: Sushena crushes the herb, gives it through the nose; Lakshmana rises. Hanuman Chalisa ch. 11 (ramcharit.in). Ramcharitmanas Lanka Kand: Meghnad's shakti (before doha 54), 'देखा सैल न औषध चीन्हा। सहसा कपि उपारि गिरि लीन्हा॥' (after doha 56).
